lines.text: One drone flight. Hundreds of rooftops. A whole neighbourhood of possibilities.
lines.spoken: One drone flight. Hundreds of rooftops. A whole neighbourhood of possibilities.

lines.text: Now imagine being able to measure that neighbourhood: the width of a road, the area of a roof, even the volume of a stockpile. All from the video you just captured.
lines.spoken: Now imagine being able to measure that neighbourhood: the width of a road, the area of a roof, even the volume of a stockpile. All from the video you just captured.

lines.text: Meet DRISHTI-3D.
lines.spoken: Meet Drishti 3D!

lines.text: Built for NTRO's single-pass reconstruction challenge, DRISHTI turns drone video and flight data into a georeferenced 3D model.
lines.spoken: Built for N T R O's single-pass reconstruction challenge, Drishti turns drone video and flight data into a geo-referenced 3D model.

lines.text: Here's our working MVP. Load the video, add the flight log, and hit Run. The application selects useful frames, solves the camera positions, and builds the model as you watch.
lines.spoken: Here's our working M V P. Load the video, add the flight log, and hit Run! The application selects useful frames, solves the camera positions, and builds the model as you watch.

lines.text: Then you can explore it, measure it, and export the results—all inside the same desktop application.
lines.spoken: Then you can explore it, measure it, and export the results, all inside the same desktop application.

lines.text: The exciting part is the engine we built underneath.
lines.spoken: The exciting part is the engine we built underneath.

lines.text: We developed our own camera-optimisation solver and GPU stereo implementation, designed around the challenges of a single flight path.
lines.spoken: We developed our own camera optimisation solver and G P U stereo implementation, designed around the challenges of a single flight path.

lines.text: Our custom solver made the camera-optimisation steps around thirteen times faster than our earlier implementation on the benchmark flight.
lines.spoken: Our custom solver made the camera optimisation steps around thirteen times faster than our earlier implementation on the benchmark flight.

lines.text: We also tested against COLMAP, the standard research tool, on the same laptop. COLMAP took thirty-three minutes for a sparse model. DRISHTI delivered a dense, textured, georeferenced model in under ten minutes.
lines.spoken: We also tested against Col Map, the standard research tool, on the same laptop. Col Map took thirty-three minutes for a sparse model. Drishti delivered a dense, textured, geo-referenced model in under ten minutes.

lines.text: And where the camera position is exact, our surface landed almost a metre closer to the surveyed points than COLMAP's.
lines.spoken: And where the camera position is exact, our surface landed almost a metre closer to the surveyed points than Col Map's.

lines.text: That's the engineering behind our promise: turn captured footage into usable geometry, with evidence for what the model has measured.
lines.spoken: That's the engineering behind our promise: turn captured footage into usable geometry, with evidence for what the model has measured.

lines.text: Here's how it comes together.
lines.spoken: Here's how it comes together.

lines.text: First, video and telemetry are aligned, and sharp, overlapping frames are selected.
lines.spoken: First, video and telemetry are aligned, and sharp, overlapping frames are selected.

lines.text: LightGlue connects matching features across those frames. Our bundle-adjustment solver then refines the cameras and lens parameters using image evidence and GPS.
lines.spoken: Light Glue connects matching features across those frames. Our bundle adjustment solver then refines the cameras and lens parameters using image evidence and G P S.

lines.text: Next, our GPU stereo implementation estimates depth. Neighbouring views cross-check those estimates before Open3D fuses them into a textured surface.
lines.spoken: Next, our G P U stereo implementation estimates depth. Neighbouring views cross check those estimates before Open 3D fuses them into a textured surface.

lines.text: The pipeline reports progress and previews to the desktop viewer while it runs. Georeferencing connects the finished model to real-world coordinates.
lines.spoken: The pipeline reports progress and previews to the desktop viewer while it runs. Geo-referencing connects the finished model to real-world coordinates.

lines.text: Now let's use it.
lines.spoken: Now let's use it!

lines.text: Switch to confidence colours to inspect reliability. Click across a road to measure distance. Outline a roof for its area. Check a volume, or trace an elevation profile.
lines.spoken: Switch to confidence colours to inspect reliability. Click across a road to measure distance. Outline a roof for its area. Check a volume, or trace an elevation profile.

lines.text: Then take those measurements into your GIS workflow with GeoJSON or KML, alongside the exported models and maps.
lines.spoken: Then take those measurements into your G I S workflow with Geo JSON or K M L, alongside the exported models and maps.

lines.text: Our recorded reconstruction contains around eight million vertices. On a separate Spain benchmark, thirteen stable features showed twenty-nine-centimetre median horizontal agreement with the national reference orthophoto.
lines.spoken: Our recorded reconstruction contains around eight million vertices. On a separate Spain benchmark, thirteen stable features showed twenty-nine centimetre median horizontal agreement with the national reference orthophoto.

lines.text: Our unique value brings these pieces together: our own reconstruction core, visible confidence on every surface, and practical measurement tools—from one flight to usable results.
lines.spoken: Our unique value brings these pieces together: our own reconstruction core, visible confidence on every surface, and practical measurement tools, from one flight to usable results.

lines.text: DRISHTI-3D. Fly once. Explore more. Measure what matters.
lines.spoken: Drishti 3D. Fly once. Explore more. Measure what matters.
